tei:div.tei:p: bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi smon lam bzhugs so: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: brtse ba chen pos lam sna drang du gsol: bdag ni 'khrul pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: thos bsam sgom gsum ma yengs 'od lam la: bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: gti mug drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad lam sna drongs: yum mchog dbyings phyug ma yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang las bsgral du gsol: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa ru skyol: zhe sdang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: me long ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpas lam sna drongs: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i= yang dag rdzogs pa'i= nga rgyal drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan lam sna drongs: yum mchog mā ma ki yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i= yang dag rdzogs pa'i= 'dod chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: sor rtogs ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas lam sna drongs: yum mchog gos dkar mo yis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i= yang dag rdzogs pa'i= phrag dog drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan don yod grub pas lam sna drongs: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol mas rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i= yang dag rdzogs pa'i= bag chags drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: lhan skyes ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam la: dpa' bo rig 'dzin rnams kyis lam sna drongs: yum mchog mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor:

bar do 'jigs pa'i= yang dag rdzogs pa'i= 'khrul snang drag pos 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshe: dngangs skrag 'jigs snang spangs pa'i 'od lam la: bcom ldan zhi khro'i tshogs kyis lam sna drongs: dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rgyab nas skyor: bar do 'jigs pa'i= yang dag rdzogs pa'i= kye ma: nam mkha'i khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas mthing kha'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: chu yi khams rnams dgra ru mi ldang zhing : sangs rgyas dkar po'i zhing khams mthong bar shog: sa yi khams rnams= sangs rgyas ser po'i= me yi khams rnams= sangs rgyas dmar po'i= rlung gi khams rnams= sangs rgyas ljang gu'i= 'ja' tshon khams rnams= sangs rgyas sna tshogs= sgra 'od zer gsum= zhi khro rab 'byams zhing khams mthong bar shog: sgra rnams thams cad rang sgrar shes par shog: 'od rnams thams cad rang 'od shes par shog: zer rnams thams cad rang zer shes par shog: bar do rang ngo rang gis shes par shog: sku gsum zhing khams mngon du 'gyur bar shog: bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi smon lam zhes bya ba o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa: 'khor ba ma stong bar du ma rdzogs so:

bar do'i smon lam 'jigs skyobs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so: kye ma: bdag ni tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe: 'jig rten 'di nas nye dus mi stongs te: rang nyid gcig pur bar dor 'khyams tsa na: rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs rje'i shugs phyungs nas: ma rig mun pa'i smag rum sel bar shog: dga' ba'i grogs dang bral nas gcir pur 'khyams: rang snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan 'char dus der: sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i shugs phyungs nas: dngangs skrag bar do'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung shog: ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lnga 'char dus der: mi 'jigs mi skrag rang ngo shes par shog: zhi dang khro bo'i sku gzugs 'char dus der: mi 'jigs gdeng thob bar do ngo shes shog: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal myong tsa na: rgyal ba zhi khros sdug bsngal sel bar shog: chos nyid rang sgra 'brug stong ldir tsa na: theg chen chos kyi sgra ru 'gyur bar shog: skyabs med las kyi rjes su 'brang dus der: rgyal ba zhi khros bdag sogs bskyab tu gsol: bag chags las kyi sdug bsngal myong tsa na: 'od gsal bde ba'i ting 'dzin 'char bar shog: srid pa bar dor brdzus te skyes tsa na: phyir log bdud kyi lung bstan mi 'byung shog: gang du bsam pa dbang gis slebs tsa na: las ngan 'khrul pa'i 'jigs skrag mi 'byung shog: gcan gzan khro bo'i ngar skad 'don pa'i tshe: yi ge drug pa'i chos sgrar 'gyur bar shog: kha char rlung dang mun pas ded pa'i tshe: ye shes gsal ba'i lha mig mthong bar shog: rigs mthun nang tshan bar do'i sems can rnams: mig ser med cing mtho ris skye bar shog: shin tu nyon mongs bkres shing skom pa'i tshe: ltogs skom tsha grang sdug bsngal mi 'byung shog: phyi ma pha ma'i 'du 'phrod mthong tsa na: rgyal ba zhi khro yab yum nyid mthong shog: gar skyes rang dbang thob nas gzhan don du: mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus mchog thob par shog:

bdag nyid skyes pa'i lus mchog thob gyur nas: mthong thos thams cad myur du grol bar shog: las ngan thams cad rjes su mi 'brang zhing : bsod nams gang yod 'phel zhing rjes 'brang shog: gang dang gang du skye ba de dang der: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: skyes ma thag tu smra shes 'gro shes te: skye ba dran cing mi brjed gzungs thob shog: yon tan che chung 'bring dang sna tshogs pa: thos sam mthong ba tsam gyis shes gyur cig: gang du skyes pa'i yul der bkra shis shog: sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig: rgyal ba zhi khro khyed sku ci 'dra dang : 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang : khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba: de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog: kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams thugs rje dang : chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i bden stobs dang : sngags 'chang rtse gcig bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyis: smon lam btab pa de bzhin 'grub gyur cig: bar do'i smon lam 'jigs skyobs ma zhes bya ba 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du ma rdzogs so:
